title: 'Mobile Tech & Future' pack in deep purple with glossy 3D phone renders and neon diagonal stripes
whatItIs: Six purple-to-navy square posts with glossy 3D phone renders on small podiums inside translucent glass circles, neon pink-orange diagonal stripe accents, X-mark dots, and headlines ('Mobile Tech & Future', 'Digital Mobile Technology', 'Mobile Tech Event').

Use diagonal neon stripes as dynamic background energy.
Vary headline phrasing while keeping the render and stripes consistent.
